name: Cute RN Retractable Badge Reel with Alligator Clip
seoTitle: Cute RN Badge Reel Gift for New Nurses
metaDescription: A cute acrylic RN badge reel with an alligator clip and a retractable cord. A useful graduation gift for a new registered nurse starting her first job.
summary: A cheerful RN badge reel that clips to scrubs and pulls out for badge scans, a small gift a new nurse will use every single shift.
whyItWorks: Few things get touched more often during a shift than a nurse's badge. It gets scanned at the med room, the supply closet, every locked door, and the time clock. A retractable reel keeps it handy without unclipping, and an RN design is a proud little signal for someone who just earned those letters.

Badge reels are also a quiet culture on most units. Nurses swap them for holidays, collect funny ones, and notice each other's. Giving a new grad a cute RN reel is a friendly welcome into that world. The title lists a 24 inch nylon cord and an alligator clip, which suit scrub tops and pockets alike. It is budget friendly, so it fits Secret Santa limits and works as an add on to a graduation card. Consider buying two so there is a spare for the locker.
goodToKnow: Some facilities require breakaway lanyards or specific reels, so it is worth a quick check with the recipient.
Acrylic designs can scratch over time, which is part of why nurses rotate several reels.
Look at the listing photos to confirm the exact artwork and colors.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: It works, since students wear ID badges in clinicals too, though the RN design is most meaningful once they pass boards.

faq.q: Will it fit a standard hospital badge?
faq.a: Most badge reels work with standard ID cards and holders, but check the listing for the clip style if their badge is unusual.
